The '''Twin-Port Ion Stream Exhaust Vent''',<ref name="Starfighter" /> also known as '''twin-port deflectors''',<ref name="SWS" /> was a component of the [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE/IN interceptor]] which controlled and channelled the exhaust from the [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter's]] [[Microparticle Ion Accelerator]] to provide thrust. The unit was made of an alloy that was a military secret.<ref name="Starfighter">''[[Starfighter Battle Book: X-wing vs TIE Interceptor]]''</ref> The deflectors were finely-tuned and were able to be controlled individually, allowing them to balance each other out during tight turns and prolonged flight maneuvers.<ref name="SWS" />
